Visitor replaces embedded iframe with custom text

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitIframe(ctx: any, src: any): string | { type: "custom"; output: string } {
        return { type: "custom", output: "[EMBEDDED: https://maps.example.com/embed]" };
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<p>Embedded map:</p><iframe src=\"https://maps.example.com/embed\" width=\"400\" height=\"300\"></iframe><p>End of map</p>", { visitor: _testVisitor as any });
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
